messages:
sophia: Hey ops — Infra manager needs to push a small promo batch: 3 IC promos, one is UK-based. They want them effective 12/01 with retro. What are the must-do steps so nothing falls through payroll/benefits?

raj: First Q: are any of the staff moving between bands or just title/comp changes? if band changes we need compensation committee + VP OK.

sophia: Two are title+comp within same band, one is bump to next band (Sr IC -> Staff). VP approval already verbal.

elaine: High level checklist: manager submits evidence packet -> people-ops intake -> compensation change spreadsheet -> Greenhouse change record -> tag #hris-pickup -> payroll cutoffs vary by country -> benefits enrollment review if FTE or level crosses threshold.

brandon: For retro pay: US payroll cutoff for December RT is 11/15; payroll needs final comp sheet by 11/10 for us to calculate retro correctly. UK/local payroll needs submission by 11/01 to include in December payroll.

hris-bot: Note: If Greenhouse change is submitted without the comp sheet, it will queue for manual HRIS processing and delay to next month. Use the exact filename pattern: comp_changes/<EMPLOYEE>-<YYYYMMDD>-promo.xlsx

elaine: Evidence template (minimal acceptable) — 3 bullets: 1) scope expansion 2) quantifiable impact 3) peer/manager/skip feedback. Example snippet: ```• Led cluster autoscaler rewrite reducing OOM incidents by 45% • Delivered cross-team SLA that improved P99 by 120ms • Skip-level: "regularly shapes platform strategy"```

raj: What about comp bands and long-term incentive eligibility? moving to Staff will make them eligible for LTI review; we need total comp mapping line item in comp sheet and proposed LTI grant recommendation from manager.

sophia: Good call — manager says they want LTI recs. Is that parallel or after compensation changes?

finance: LTI recommendations can be submitted alongside promo packet, but final grant is processed on the normal cadence. For any retro grant value, finance will advise tax implications for the UK.

brandon: Benefits note: if this triggers base salary above the benefits threshold (US medical eligibility tiers), benefits COBRA/plan enrollment windows might change — benefits team needs to review before effective date.

elaine: Action items: 1) Sophia: collect 3 evidence docs + LTI recommendation by 11/03. 2) Raj: confirm VP signature recorded in the packet by 11/04. 3) Brandon: upload comp_changes files with exact filename pattern by 11/10. 4) Sophia to create GH change record and tag #hris-pickup once upload is done.

sophia: Sounds good. If any deadline slips we default effective date to 01/01. Also, manager asked if we can do partial retro (base only). Is that supported?

finance: We generally process retro for base + annual bonus pro-rata only. Equity retro is not backdated. Document manager decision in the packet.

hris-bot: Reminder: After GH change + comp sheet, HRIS will push to payroll queue within 48 business hours. Confirm final comp numbers in the spreadsheet with payroll reconcile column filled.

raj: One systems gotcha — Hiring/comp API sometimes strips currency tag if file name lacks _GBP/_USD. Please add currency column in the sheet and include currency shorthand in filename.

elaine: Final note: For UK promo, ask manager to confirm legal name and bank details are up to date to avoid payment issues.

sophia: Thanks all — I'll consolidate and ping this thread when uploads are done. :thumbsup:
